images.filename: MDDS 03.0001 Replika Pakaian Kebesaran Kesultanan Serdang 01.jpg
images.caption:
Pakaian kebesaran Kesultanan Serdang adalah pakaian adat melayu lengkap yang digunakan oleh sultan. Pakaian ini memiliki filosofi dan makna yang berkaitan dengan adat istiadat suku melayu. Adapun rincian dari pakaian tersebut adalah :
1. Kain samping (Kain sarung dilipat dua yang dipakai di pinggang dengan kepala kain dibelakang)
2. Tengkuluk
3. Pisau Tumbuk Lada
4. Selempang

5. Bengkong (Ikat pinggang untuk menutupi lipatan kain samping)

images.filename: Princes of Deli, Serdang and Langkat outside the Dutch Pavilion of the Colonial World Exhibition, Paris 1931.png
images.caption:
The Princes of Lankat, Deli and Serdang outside of the second Dutch pavilion at the Colonial World Exhibition in Paris 1931
Image has been Gamma-Corrected.
Original Image: Wereld Museum NL TM-60047536.
Location: Europe-South / Paris / Ville de Paris (department) / Europe / France / Île de France 1931.
Other Title: Opening photos - Second Pavilion
Additional Info: From a Facebook post, the persons are:
Tunku Bendahara Amiruddin of Deli,
Tunku Mahkota Rajih Anwar of Serdang, and
Tunku Besar Ottman of Deli.
The same persons are also shown here.

These royal families were all murdered in the East Sumatra Social Revolution of 1946.
